proposal.summary: Lansweeper 6.0.x through 7.2.x default installations allow unauthenticated access to a Built-in Admin function, enabling command execution via the Add New Package and Scheduled Deployments features.
proposal.cwe_quote: By default, everyone in your network can access all of Lansweeper's features and menus simply by browsing to the web console URL and hitting the Built-in Admin button.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Restrict network access to the Lansweeper web console, disable or reconfigure the Built-in Admin account, and apply any vendor-supplied patches or configuration changes that remove the default built-in admin behaviour. If exposed, audit for signs of unauthorized command execution.

evidence_quotes.claim: Default installation allows built-in admin access without authentication
evidence_quotes.quote: By default, everyone in your network can access all of Lansweeper's features and menus simply by browsing to the web console URL and hitting the Built-in Admin button.
This allows command execution via the Add New Package and Scheduled Deployments features.
The Lansweeper application is agentless network inventory software that can be used for IT asset management.
